metadata.description: Retrieve a list of landing pages in your HubSpot account.
metadata.learn_more: Retrieve a list of landing pages in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to filter landing pages based on creation and update timestamps, sort them, and paginate through results. You can also choose to include archived pages or specify certain properties to be included in the response.

after.label: After
after.description: The cursor token value to get the next set of results. You can get this from the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Specifies whether to return deleted Landing Pages. Defaults to `false`.

createdAfter.label: Created After
createdAfter.description: Filter landing pages created after a specific date and time.

createdAt.label: Created At
createdAt.description: Only return Landing Pages created at exactly the specified time.

createdBefore.label: Created Before
createdBefore.description: Filter landing pages created before a specific date and time.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: The maximum number of results to return. Default is 100.

property.label: Property
property.description: Specifies which properties of the landing pages to include in the response.

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Specifies which fields to use for sorting results. Valid fields are `name`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `createdBy`, `updatedBy`. `createdAt` will be used by default.

updatedAfter.label: Updated After
updatedAfter.description: Only return Landing Pages last updated after the specified time.

updatedAt.label: Updated At
updatedAt.description: Only return Landing Pages last updated at exactly the specified time.

updatedBefore.label: Updated Before
updatedBefore.description: Only return Landing Pages last updated before the specified time.
